interface.longDescription:
Make everyday family organization easier with FamilyWall in ChatGPT.
Stay on top of your family’s busy schedule, manage shopping and to-do lists, and get quick answers about what’s coming up, all through simple conversations.
Ask what’s happening this weekend, add an appointment to your family calendar, create a grocery list, or check what’s left on your to-do list.
From coordinating activities to keeping everyday plans on track, FamilyWall helps your family stay organized without the extra effort.
defaultPrompt: What’s on our family calendar this week?
Add soccer practice to our family calendar for Thursday at 4 PM.
Add milk, eggs, bananas, and bread to our grocery list.

positive.description: Create a new event on the FamilyWall calendar.
positive.prompt: Add a calendar event called "Dentist Appointment" for next Tuesday from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM.
positive.expected_behavior: A new event titled "Dentist Appointment" is created on the user's FamilyWall calendar for next Tuesday, from 2:00 PM to 3:00 PM. ChatGPT confirms the event was created and shows its details.

positive.description: Retrieve events scheduled on the FamilyWall calendar.
positive.prompt: What's on my FamilyWall calendar for next Tuesday?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT retrieves the calendar events for next Tuesday and presents them clearly, with titles and times. If the first test case ran, the response includes "Dentist Appointment" at 2:00 PM. If no events exist that day, ChatGPT says none were found.

positive.description: Create a new shopping list containing multiple items.
positive.prompt: Create a shopping list called "Weekend Groceries" with milk, eggs, bread, and bananas.
positive.expected_behavior: A new list named "Weekend Groceries" is created in FamilyWall with four items: milk, eggs, bread and bananas. ChatGPT confirms the list was created and shows its contents.

positive.description: Add a new item to an existing FamilyWall shopping list. Run after the "Weekend Groceries" test case.
positive.prompt: Add orange juice to my "Weekend Groceries" list.
positive.expected_behavior: "Orange juice" is added to the existing "Weekend Groceries" list. ChatGPT confirms the item was added without creating a duplicate list.

positive.description: Retrieve the contents of an existing FamilyWall list. Run after the two "Weekend Groceries" test cases.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT retrieves the "Weekend Groceries" list and shows its items: milk, eggs, bread, bananas and orange juice. No changes are made to the list.

negative.description: The user asks for general advice about organizing a family calendar, not to read or change their FamilyWall calendar. ChatGPT can answer from general knowledge, so there's no reason to read the user's calendar.
negative.prompt: What's the best way to organize a busy family calendar with multiple kids' activities?

negative.description: The user asks ChatGPT to suggest grocery items, not to save or retrieve a FamilyWall list. ChatGPT should write the list itself. It may offer to save the items to FamilyWall, but shouldn't call the plugin unless the user asks.
negative.prompt: Can you make me a grocery list for taco night for four people?

negative.description: The user asks a general question about calendars, not for information from their own family calendar. ChatGPT can explain the difference without accessing FamilyWall.
negative.prompt: What's the difference between a recurring calendar event and a regular event?

es-419.subtitle: La vida familiar, más fácil.
es-419.description:
Organiza la vida familiar de todos los días más fácilmente con FamilyWall en ChatGPT.
Mantente al día con la agenda de tu familia, administra listas de compras y tareas, y obtén respuestas rápidas sobre lo que viene, todo mediante conversaciones sencillas.
Pregunta qué hay planeado para el fin de semana, agrega una cita al calendario familiar, crea una lista de compras o revisa qué tareas quedan pendientes.
Desde coordinar actividades hasta mantener los planes diarios en orden, FamilyWall ayuda a tu familia a organizarse sin esfuerzo adicional.

es-ES.subtitle: La vida familiar, más fácil.
es-ES.description:
Organiza la vida familiar del día a día más fácilmente con FamilyWall en ChatGPT.
Mantente al tanto de la agenda de tu familia, gestiona listas de la compra y de tareas, y obtén respuestas rápidas sobre los próximos planes, todo mediante conversaciones sencillas.
Pregunta qué hay previsto para el fin de semana, añade una cita al calendario familiar, crea una lista de la compra o consulta qué tareas quedan pendientes.
Desde coordinar actividades hasta mantener los planes cotidianos al día, FamilyWall ayuda a tu familia a organizarse sin esfuerzo adicional.

fr-FR.subtitle: La vie de famille simplifiée.
fr-FR.description:
Simplifiez l’organisation du quotidien familial avec FamilyWall dans ChatGPT.
Gardez un œil sur l’emploi du temps chargé de votre famille, gérez vos listes de courses et de tâches et obtenez rapidement des réponses sur les événements à venir, le tout par de simples conversations.
Demandez ce qui est prévu ce week-end, ajoutez un rendez-vous au calendrier familial, créez une liste de courses ou vérifiez les tâches qu’il reste à faire.
De la coordination des activités au suivi des projets du quotidien, FamilyWall aide votre famille à rester organisée sans effort supplémentaire.

de-DE.subtitle: Familienalltag leicht gemacht.
de-DE.description:
Mit FamilyWall in ChatGPT wird die Organisation des Familienalltags einfacher.
Behalte den vollen Terminkalender deiner Familie im Blick, verwalte Einkaufs- und Aufgabenlisten und erhalte schnell Antworten auf Fragen zu anstehenden Terminen – alles in einfachen Gesprächen.
Frag, was am Wochenende ansteht, füge einen Termin zum Familienkalender hinzu, erstelle eine Einkaufsliste oder prüfe, welche Aufgaben noch offen sind.
Von der Abstimmung gemeinsamer Aktivitäten bis zur Planung des Alltags hilft FamilyWall deiner Familie, ohne zusätzlichen Aufwand organisiert zu bleiben.

nl-NL.subtitle: Gezinsleven, simpel geregeld.
nl-NL.description:
Maak het dagelijkse gezinsleven eenvoudiger te organiseren met FamilyWall in ChatGPT.
Houd de drukke agenda van je gezin bij, beheer boodschappen- en takenlijsten en krijg snel antwoord op vragen over wat er op de planning staat, allemaal via eenvoudige gesprekken.
Vraag wat er dit weekend gepland staat, voeg een afspraak toe aan de gezinsagenda, maak een boodschappenlijst of bekijk welke taken nog openstaan.
Van het afstemmen van activiteiten tot het bijhouden van dagelijkse plannen: FamilyWall helpt je gezin georganiseerd te blijven zonder extra moeite.

pt-BR.subtitle: Vida em família simplificada.
pt-BR.description:
Facilite a organização do dia a dia da família com o FamilyWall no ChatGPT.
Acompanhe a agenda movimentada da sua família, gerencie listas de compras e tarefas e receba respostas rápidas sobre os próximos compromissos, tudo por meio de conversas simples.
Pergunte o que está programado para o fim de semana, adicione um compromisso ao calendário da família, crie uma lista de compras ou confira as tarefas pendentes.
De coordenar atividades a manter os planos do dia a dia em ordem, o FamilyWall ajuda sua família a se organizar sem esforço extra.

pt-PT.subtitle: Vida em família mais simples.
pt-PT.description:
Simplifique a organização do dia a dia da família com o FamilyWall no ChatGPT.
Acompanhe a agenda preenchida da sua família, gira listas de compras e de tarefas e obtenha respostas rápidas sobre os próximos compromissos, tudo através de conversas simples.
Pergunte o que está previsto para o fim de semana, adicione um compromisso ao calendário familiar, crie uma lista de compras ou consulte as tarefas que faltam concluir.
Desde coordenar atividades até manter os planos diários em ordem, o FamilyWall ajuda a sua família a organizar-se sem esforço adicional.

it-IT.subtitle: Vita in famiglia più facile.
it-IT.description:
Semplifica l’organizzazione della vita quotidiana in famiglia con FamilyWall in ChatGPT.
Tieni sotto controllo gli impegni della tua famiglia, gestisci le liste della spesa e delle cose da fare e ottieni risposte rapide sui prossimi appuntamenti, il tutto con semplici conversazioni.
Chiedi cosa c’è in programma per il weekend, aggiungi un appuntamento al calendario di famiglia, crea una lista della spesa o controlla quali attività restano da completare.
Dal coordinamento delle attività alla gestione dei programmi quotidiani, FamilyWall aiuta la tua famiglia a restare organizzata senza ulteriori sforzi.

ja-JP.subtitle: 家族の毎日を、もっと簡単に。
ja-JP.description:
ChatGPTのFamilyWallで、毎日の家族の予定管理をもっと簡単に。
家族の忙しいスケジュールを把握し、買い物リストやToDoリストを管理。これからの予定も、自然な会話ですぐに確認できます。
「今週末の予定は？」「家族のカレンダーに通院の予定を追加して」「買い物リストを作って」「残っているタスクは？」など、気軽に話しかけてください。
家族の活動の調整から日々の予定の管理まで、FamilyWallなら手間を増やさずに家族の暮らしを整理できます。

ru-RU.subtitle: Семейные дела — проще.
ru-RU.description:
С FamilyWall в ChatGPT организовывать повседневную жизнь семьи стало проще.
Следите за насыщенным семейным расписанием, управляйте списками покупок и дел и быстро узнавайте о предстоящих событиях — просто общаясь в чате.
Спросите, что запланировано на выходные, добавьте встречу в семейный календарь, создайте список покупок или проверьте, какие дела ещё остались.
От согласования совместных занятий до повседневных планов — FamilyWall помогает вашей семье оставаться организованной без лишних усилий.

ko-KR.subtitle: 가족의 일상을 더 간편하게.
ko-KR.description:
ChatGPT에서 FamilyWall로 가족의 일상을 더 쉽게 관리하세요.
바쁜 가족 일정을 한눈에 확인하고, 장보기 목록과 할 일 목록을 관리하고, 앞으로의 계획을 간단한 대화로 빠르게 알아볼 수 있습니다.
이번 주말 일정을 물어보거나, 가족 캘린더에 약속을 추가하거나, 장보기 목록을 만들거나, 남은 할 일을 확인해 보세요.
가족 활동을 조율하는 일부터 매일의 계획을 챙기는 일까지, FamilyWall은 번거로움을 더하지 않고 가족이 체계적으로 생활하도록 도와줍니다.

sv-SE.subtitle: Enklare familjeliv.
sv-SE.description:
Gör det enklare att organisera familjens vardag med FamilyWall i ChatGPT.
Håll koll på familjens fullspäckade schema, hantera inköps- och att göra-listor och få snabba svar om vad som väntar – allt genom enkla samtal.
Fråga vad som händer i helgen, lägg till en tid i familjekalendern, skapa en inköpslista eller se vilka uppgifter som återstår.
Från att samordna aktiviteter till att hålla ordning på vardagsplanerna hjälper FamilyWall familjen att vara organiserad utan extra ansträngning.

publication.release_notes:
The first release of the FamilyWall MCP server. Claude and ChatGPT can read and update one family's
FamilyWall calendar, lists and meal plan, acting as the member who connected them.

- Calendar: see events from every calendar the member has switched on in FamilyWall, including
  tasks with a due date, birthdays, holidays and connected Google, Outlook and ICS calendars. Add
  one-off and repeating events, and edit or delete events on the family calendar. For a repeating
  event, change or delete just one occurrence, that one and those after it, or the whole series.
- Lists: see lists and their items, create lists, add items, edit an item's text, due date or
  repeat, tick items off, and delete items and lists. New items get the category the FamilyWall
  app would give them, and an item already open on the list isn't added twice.
- Meals: see the meal plan under the family's own meal names, plan dishes on any meal the family
  shows in FamilyWall, and find the family's recipes to plan them. Move a meal or some of its
  dishes to another day or meal, set how many it serves, and delete a meal or some of its dishes.
- Family: see the family's members, get an overview of the week, and search across events, lists
  and meals.

Access and limits:

- Connecting takes a FamilyWall sign-in by a member of the family. Each connection covers one
  family, picked when connecting, and that family needs FamilyWall Premium.
- If the family's Premium ends, the assistant stops working until Premium is renewed. The
  connection stays, so there is no need to connect again.
- The assistant has the member's own rights in FamilyWall, no more. It can't send messages, change
  settings or see the member's other families.
- Only events on the family calendar can be changed. Connected calendars, birthdays and holidays
  are read-only.
- Every event, list and list item the assistant adds gets a note saying it was added through the
  assistant.
- The assistant is told to do only what the member asked, to ask which list or event is meant when
  more than one could match, and to report exactly what worked and what didn't.
- Deletes can't be undone. The assistant is told to confirm with the member before it deletes an
  event or a whole meal, and before it deletes or changes many items at once.
- The calendar, the week overview, search, today's meals, and any list whose items have or are
  given a due date or repeat need the member's time zone from their FamilyWall profile. If it has
  none, opening the FamilyWall app once on the phone sets it.
- A connection lasts at most 90 days. After that, connect again. It ends sooner when the member
  disconnects the assistant, stops the connection in FamilyWall, or leaves the family.
